patch_description: Keeps the greedy seed plus move/1-for-1 swap local search from the current program, and adds a 2-for-1 exchange phase as recommended: replace one model on the worst GPU with two smaller models from another GPU (or vice versa) when a simple swap cannot lower the global max KVPR. All feasibility checks mirror the existing pattern (recomputed free memory > 0, strict 1e-12 improvement on the global max). This handles size-vs-rate asymmetries where a large model must be shed but no single replacement balances rate.
